riskRationale: The new scripts/project-root.js module uses __dirname-relative path resolution to compute the project root. If the computation is wrong for any script location, it could silently break path resolution in runtime scripts and launch agents. The plist changes are particularly sensitive — a broken path in a launchd plist causes the service to fail at OS level. The task being cancelled may indicate the work was abandoned for a reason (e.g., discovered a flaw in the approach, or the paths were fixed another way). No PR means no review gate was applied.
recommendation: Human review required before any action. Specifically: (1) verify scripts/project-root.js logic is correct for all calling script locations — some scripts are nested (scripts/db/, scripts/utilities/) which may compute different __dirname values; (2) check whether main already has equivalent path fixes via another route (the task was cancelled 2 months ago); (3) if the work is valid, create a new task to open a PR for QC review rather than directly merging. Do NOT auto-delete — the work represents real effort. Do NOT auto-merge — plist + runtime path changes without review is high risk.
